# Generated by tools/build_cultivation_population.py.
# Raise only missing XP. Count is a hard safety bound, never a recurring grant.
ac_ensure_core_floor_effect = {
	while = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_trait_xp = { trait = ac_cultivator track = ac_core_$CORE$ value >= $XP$ } } }
		count = 20
		add_trait_xp = { trait = ac_cultivator track = ac_core_$CORE$ value = 5 }
	}
}
ac_ensure_foundation_floor_effect = {
	while = {
		limit = { NOT = { ac_foundation_xp_trigger = { XP = $XP$ } } }
		count = 20
		ac_gain_foundation_xp_effect = { XP = 5 }
	}
}
ac_develop_upper_effect = {
	if = { limit = { ac_has_foundation_trigger = no } ac_random_foundation_effect = yes }
	random_list = {
		1 = { ac_ensure_core_floor_effect = { CORE = soul XP = 30 } }
		1 = { ac_ensure_core_floor_effect = { CORE = soul XP = 35 } }
		1 = { ac_ensure_core_floor_effect = { CORE = soul XP = 40 } }
		1 = { ac_ensure_core_floor_effect = { CORE = soul XP = 45 } }
		1 = { ac_ensure_core_floor_effect = { CORE = soul XP = 50 } }
	}
	random_list = {
		1 = { ac_ensure_core_floor_effect = { CORE = agility XP = 30 } }
		1 = { ac_ensure_core_floor_effect = { CORE = agility XP = 35 } }
		1 = { ac_ensure_core_floor_effect = { CORE = agility XP = 40 } }
		1 = { ac_ensure_core_floor_effect = { CORE = agility XP = 45 } }
		1 = { ac_ensure_core_floor_effect = { CORE = agility XP = 50 } }
	}
	random_list = {
		1 = { ac_ensure_core_floor_effect = { CORE = power XP = 30 } }
		1 = { ac_ensure_core_floor_effect = { CORE = power XP = 35 } }
		1 = { ac_ensure_core_floor_effect = { CORE = power XP = 40 } }
		1 = { ac_ensure_core_floor_effect = { CORE = power XP = 45 } }
		1 = { ac_ensure_core_floor_effect = { CORE = power XP = 50 } }
	}
	random_list = {
		1 = { ac_ensure_core_floor_effect = { CORE = fortitude XP = 30 } }
		1 = { ac_ensure_core_floor_effect = { CORE = fortitude XP = 35 } }
		1 = { ac_ensure_core_floor_effect = { CORE = fortitude XP = 40 } }
		1 = { ac_ensure_core_floor_effect = { CORE = fortitude XP = 45 } }
		1 = { ac_ensure_core_floor_effect = { CORE = fortitude XP = 50 } }
	}
	random_list = {
		1 = { ac_ensure_foundation_floor_effect = { XP = 50 } }
		1 = { ac_ensure_foundation_floor_effect = { XP = 60 } }
		1 = { ac_ensure_foundation_floor_effect = { XP = 70 } }
	}
	ac_update_visual_age_effect = yes
}
ac_develop_master_effect = {
	if = { limit = { ac_has_foundation_trigger = no } ac_random_foundation_effect = yes }
	random_list = {
		1 = { ac_ensure_core_floor_effect = { CORE = soul XP = 60 } }
		1 = { ac_ensure_core_floor_effect = { CORE = soul XP = 65 } }

# Rank changes grant a baseline once; stronger progress is never reduced.
ac_sect_develop_rank_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_trait = ac_cultivator is_alive = yes age >= 16 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = ac_sect_master OR = { NOT = { has_variable = ac_development_rank } var:ac_development_rank < 2 } }
			ac_develop_master_effect = yes
			set_variable = { name = ac_development_rank value = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_trait = ac_sect_upper_disciple OR = { NOT = { has_variable = ac_development_rank } var:ac_development_rank < 1 } }
			ac_develop_upper_effect = yes
			set_variable = { name = ac_development_rank value = 1 }
		}
	}
}
